summary: Mentor can now tell you in simple words what each update brings, and its version reads like a date.
Mentor Settings has an Updates tab: every update this Mentor had, and Ask Mentor to go over one with you.
Mentor now warns you and asks first before it restarts to install an update.
In Mentor Settings, Updates, the list of updates is sorted by year and month.
Mentor Settings now uses the whole width of the window, like the Recipes app.
When something does not work as expected, you can tell Mentor's maker: right-click the desktop, Report a problem.
